```{python}
#| echo: false

# =================
# Imports and Setup
# =================

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib as mpl

from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.manifold import TSNE

df = pd.read_parquet("Projects/Analysis/rep_species_profiles.parquet")

aa_columns = [
    "Ala", "Arg", "Asn", "Asp", "Cys",
    "Gln", "Glu", "Gly", "His", "Ile",
    "Leu", "Lys", "Met", "Phe", "Pro",
    "Ser", "Thr", "Trp", "Tyr", "Val"
]
pct_columns = [aa + "_pct" for aa in aa_columns]

def extract_phylum(lineage):
    for token in lineage.split(";"):
        if token.startswith("p__"):
            name = token[3:]
            return name if name else "Unclassified"
    return "Unclassified"

df["Phylum"] = df["Lineage"].apply(extract_phylum)

X = df[pct_columns].values
labels = df["Phylum"].values
X_scaled = StandardScaler().fit_transform(X)

unique_labels = sorted(df["Phylum"].unique())

cmap = mpl.colormaps["tab20"].resampled(len(unique_labels))
COLOR_MAP = {lab: cmap(i) for i, lab in enumerate(unique_labels)}
```


# GC Composition Plots
```{python}
#| echo: false

# ===================
# GC Composition Plot
# ===================

fig, axes = plt.subplots(10, 2, figsize=(12, 24))
axes = axes.flatten()

for ax, aa, pct_col in zip(axes, aa_columns, pct_columns):
    for lab, color in COLOR_MAP.items():
        mask = labels == lab
        ax.scatter(df.loc[mask, "GC_content"], df.loc[mask, pct_col],
                   color=color, alpha=0.5, s=8, linewidths=0)
    ax.set_title(aa)
    ax.set_xlabel("GC content (%)")
    ax.set_ylabel("AA composition (%)")

handles, labels_legend = [], []
for lab, color in COLOR_MAP.items():
    handles.append(plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker="o", color="w",
                              markerfacecolor=color, markersize=6))
    labels_legend.append(lab)
fig.legend(handles, labels_legend, loc="lower center", ncol=5, fontsize=8,
           bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.02))

fig.suptitle("GC Content vs Amino Acid Composition by Phylum", fontsize=16, y=1.0)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.98])
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| echo: false

# =========================================
# Dimension Reduction and Manifold Learning
# =========================================

def plot_embedding(X_embed, title, ax=None):
    standalone = ax is None
    if standalone:
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
    for lab, color in COLOR_MAP.items():
        mask = labels == lab
        ax.scatter(X_embed[mask, 0], X_embed[mask, 1],
                   label=lab, color=color, alpha=0.5, s=8, linewidths=0)
    ax.set_title(title)
    if standalone:
        plt.tight_layout()
        plt.show()
```

# PCA
```{python}
#| echo: false

# PCA
pca = PCA(n_components=2)
X_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_scaled)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
plot_embedding(X_pca, "PCA of Species AA Profiles by Phylum", ax)
ax.set_xlabel("PC1")
ax.set_ylabel("PC2")
ax.legend(markerscale=2, fontsize=6, ncol=2,
          loc="center left", bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 0.5))
print(f"Total variance explained: {pca.explained_variance_ratio_.sum():.2%}")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

# t-SNE
```{python}
#| echo: false

# t-SNE
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15, 5))
for ax, perp in zip(axes, [15, 30, 45]):
    tsne = TSNE(n_components=2, random_state=42, perplexity=perp)
    X_tsne = tsne.fit_transform(X_scaled)
    plot_embedding(X_tsne, f"perplexity={perp}", ax)

handles, labels_legend = axes[-1].get_legend_handles_labels()
fig.legend(handles, labels_legend, markerscale=2, fontsize=6, ncol=1,
           loc="center left", bbox_to_anchor=(1.0, 0.5))
fig.suptitle("t-SNE of Species AA Profiles by Phylum", fontsize=14)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.88, 0.95])
plt.show()
```
